items.required_rule: Parent effective model tools limited to web_search,web_extract,delegate_task; leaf children only web_search,web_extract. items.required_rule: Model text alone never witnesses two actual children. Producer-owned trusted runtime binds separate child ids/session refs, real native function path and completion status, exact role, request/source cutoff, bound input/output hashes and origin classification. Plain -z stdout is insufficient without trusted child events. Preferred minimal observer: same-process bounded wrappers around upstream tools.delegate_tool._build_child_agent (pre-inference tool/session witness) and _run_single_child (terminal completion witness), both calling original native implementation. Their call-site imports from delegate_tool_results._build_child_preserving_parent_tools and delegate_tool_dispatch._Batch.run_child are verified at exact pin; no on-disk upstream modification.
items.validation_rule: The original pinned upstream builder and runner execute twice; observer binds project role by task index, native session/subagent IDs, exact effective pre-inference tools, completion/digest and real/UNKNOWN cost; model claims, best-effort event callbacks and stdout-only substitutes fail; observer must not outlive invocation.
